question: Who does claire from mcleods daughters end up with?
text: **Spoiler:** Claire McLeod gets together with **Alex Ryan** in Season 3 of *McLeod’s Daughters*. They never marry: Claire dies in a car accident before Alex gets the chance to propose. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oaotBjHJaH0&utm_source=openai))
